CustomField.description: Used to display custom, read-only messages to the user on the form. Only applicable for the "Display Text" Field Type. The content entered here will be rendered natively in the LWC using the lightning-formatted-rich-text component.
CustomField.inlineHelpText:
Enter the exact text or HTML you want to display on the form (e.g., use for bold,
for line breaks, or for links). Note: This field is only rendered if the Field Type is "Display Text".
CustomField.label: HTML Content
